rollback.command: The same executable loads the restored shader bundle.
rollback.observed: The native key and final capture match the baseline exactly.

execution_context: UE reference process remained alive while performing first shader compilation. Resource availability was checked before every runtime invocation. These runs establish API, pixel-change, rollback and exit behavior; no performance conclusion is made.
scope: Combined GI, environment importance sampling and geometry module source. UE ran concurrently; only validation, pixels and exit behavior are assessed.
metadata_paths: Published paths are repository-relative. Original private command records preserve the executed absolute paths.
